input.summary: Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Ooty), contact Prakash. Quote received: glycerine Rs118/kg; rosemary extract 20% rosmarinic Rs7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg, shelf life 12 months; caffeine Rs1650/kg only if one full lot (size not stated); freight extra ~Rs9/kg; 50% advance, balance on delivery; delivery 3 weeks. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection, new to Kesavi, certificates under renewal (to send later), COA only after order. Unresolved: glycerin MOQ and shelf life; caffeine MOQ in kg and shelf life; knockout Q9 (SDS, leave-on suitability); Q6 certs/rejection rate; Q7 MOQ/shelf life; Q8 manufacturer vs trader. Requested questionnaire not yet answered. Note: rosemary MOQ 100 kg vs 28 kg need is a commercial point for buyer.

input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on your quote (Glycerin, Caffeine) and mandatory questions
input.body:
Dear Mr. Prakash,

Thank you for your quotation for KPC-2026-014. To evaluate it, we need the following information:

Glycerin (RM-002)
1. Minimum order quantity in kg.
2. Total shelf life in months, and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005)
3. The size of "one full lot" in kg.
4. Total shelf life in months, and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Compliance (mandatory)
5. Please provide the Safety Data Sheet for each material you quote and confirm that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Quality (mandatory)
6. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold with their expiry dates. Please send the renewal status and expected dates for the certificates under renewal.

Supply risk (mandatory)
7. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please also send a certificate of analysis for each quoted material with your reply, as we need it to assess the quote before order placement.

Please reply with the numbered answers by reply to this email. Our first need-by date is 20 December 2026.

Regards,
Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
